CSIR NEERI Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate-I position at CSIR NEERI is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Associate-I position, candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Environmental Sciences, Botany, or Zoology from a university recognized by the government.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 31,000, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position at CSIR NEERI as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Project Associate-I position will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the CSIR NEERI office located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Project Associate-I position at CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of their ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the official notification.
